title: Estimation of Lévy-driven CARMA models under renewal sampling
summary: Continuous-time autoregressive and moving average (CARMA) models are extensively used to model high-frequency and irregularly sampled data. We study Whittle estimation for the model parameters when the process is observed at renewal times. The driving noise is assumed to be a Lévy process allowing for more flexibility including heavy-tailed marginal distributions and jumps in the sample paths. We show that the Whittle estimator based on the integrated periodogram is consistent and asymptotically normal under very mild conditions.
